historical_growth.growth_rate_source: Base-case 10-year revenue path average, not a historical CAGR. Every historical CAGR (35-58%) is from the pre-saturation store roll-out and the 2025 delivery-subsidy surge, and H1 FY2026 revenue grew 2.3% with net profit -14.7%. Using any of them as a forward proxy would be wrong by a factor of five.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (49.1%) diverges by more than 30% from revenue CAGR (35.2%); the gap is the IPO raise plus retained cash, not operating growth. The 2.3% H1 FY2026 revenue growth diverges from every historical rate.

scenario_narratives.base: MIXUE remains China's low-price volume leader but the store roll-out has matured. FY2026 revenue is roughly flat (+1%) as H2 laps the 2025 food-delivery subsidy surge. Growth then settles in the mid-single digits, driven by net store adds in lower-tier cities, Lucky Cup coffee, FULU fresh beer and overseas stores, while China same-store volumes go nowhere. Operating EBITDA margin stays near the H1 FY2026 level of ~22%, below the 23-25% of FY2024-25. The supply-chain cost advantage holds, but the price war takes away the margin that scale used to add. The large cash pile (~RMB20.6bn after the special dividend, ~38% of market cap) carries a big share of the value.
scenario_narratives.bull: The H1 FY2026 slowdown turns out to be the base effect management described. Once the subsidy war is regulated down, order volumes normalise. Lucky Cup takes share from Luckin and Cotti at the low end on MIXUE's own supply chain, FULU replicates the franchise model in draft beer, and international expansion (Southeast Asia, Kazakhstan, US) becomes a second engine. Revenue compounds at ~10% for five years and margin recovers to ~23.5% as the smart-dispenser rollout and mix lift unit economics.
scenario_narratives.bear: The analysts disputing management's base-effect story are right. Faster-growing rivals take share in MIXUE's core lower-tier market, closures exceed openings in China, and MIXUE cuts its ingredient mark-up to keep franchisees solvent, pushing operating EBITDA margin toward 18%. A repeat of the 2022/2023/2025 food-safety incidents under heightened SAMR and CCTV 3.15 scrutiny costs a year of growth. Revenue falls ~9% cumulatively over FY2026-FY2028, then grows only at ~2%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on RMB flows discounted at an RMB 9% cost of equity and converted to HKD at 1.1724. Year 1 is anchored to the decelerated H1 FY2026 run-rate, not FY2025. Net cash includes deposits and WMPs, less the declared special dividend, because their income is stripped from the flows. Leases are charged in the flows and NCI in the bridge.
key_risks_to_valuation: Share loss to Chabaidao / Guming / Hushang Ayi turns the H1 FY2026 deceleration into multi-year revenue decline
Food-safety or franchise-liability regulation event (SAMR, CCTV 3.15) across ~64,000 independently owned stores
Margin: ingredient mark-up given back to franchisees in the delivery-platform price war
Cash-pile capital allocation: ~RMB20bn of liquidity spent on low-return M&A (FULU-style) instead of returned
CNY/HKD rate and PRC capital-control risk on the cash pile

inputs.share_count_basis: 379.619m H + unlisted shares on issue at 30 Jun 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim balance sheet, share capital RMB379,619k at RMB1 par); interim note states the Group has no dilutive potential ordinary shares, so basic = diluted. Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. The H Share Award Scheme adopted 26 Jun 2026 has no grants outstanding yet.
inputs.cash_note: Gross liquidity RMB21,640.7m at 30 Jun 2026 per the interim MD&A (cash and cash equivalents 6,027.9 + time deposits and restricted cash 7,526.7 [current 5,810.2, non-current 1,716.6] + wealth-management products in FVTPL ~8,086), less the RMB2.65/share special dividend (~RMB1,006.0m, payable 6 Nov 2026, declared after the balance-sheet date) = RMB20,634.7m. Interest-bearing bank borrowings nil at 30 Jun 2026 (RMB28.2m repaid in H1). Using the strict cash-and-equivalents line (6,027.9) alone would omit ~RMB14.6bn of deposits and WMPs whose income is stripped from the flows, which breaks the matching-asset rule. If the quote is still cum-dividend, IV is understated by ~HK$3.1/share.
inputs.interest_income_note: FY2025 bank interest income RMB219.1m (income statement note 6) deducted from reported FCF. FVTPL investment income (RMB110.9m FY2025) is realised in investing cash flows, so it is not inside reported FCF; it is excluded from the forward EBITDA margin all the same, because the WMPs that earn it sit in the bridge.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report consolidated cash flow statement: equity-settled share-based payment expenses RMB18,531k (FY2024 15,786k; H1 FY2026 4,632k). No net-share-settlement tax line (EquityAwardTaxes = 0).
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases since listing (ShareRepurchases = 0 every period). The flat count is a modelling convention, not something the company funds; SBC is ~0.06% of revenue so the convention is immaterial here.
inputs.fx_note: HKD per CNY 1.1724, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:02Z. Parity check via USD crosses: HKD=X 7.8479 / CNY=X 6.6768 = 1.1754, a 0.26% tie, confirming direction (multiply CNY values by 1.1724 to get HKD). No A-share listing to parity-check the equity. refresh_price.py does not update this rate.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are RMB, so the rate is RMB-built: China 10y government bond ~1.9% + equity beta 1.0 x 7.1% ERP (mature-market ~5% plus a ~2pp China country / H-share governance premium) = 9.0% cost of equity. No debt, so WACC = cost of equity. The same 9.0% is used in all three scenarios: the competitive, food-safety and regulatory risks are carried in the bear-case flows and the 30% bear weight, not in a stacked discount-rate premium. Terminal growth 2.0% (below CN nominal GDP, roughly at the RMB risk-free rate).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: the full lease cash payment (principal RMB91.7m + interest RMB4.9m FY2025, 0.29% of revenue; H1 FY2026 54.3m + 3.2m = 0.38%) is charged via lease_cost_pct_path inside EBIT, D&A excludes right-of-use depreciation (RMB103.5m FY2025), and lease liabilities (RMB227.8m at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. Immaterial either way (<0.5% of EV).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (100%); NCI charged once via the equity bridge at book value (RMB332.3m at 30 Jun 2026). NCI takes ~1% of group profit (H1 FY2026 profit RMB2,319.3m total vs 2,296.3m attributable).
inputs.ebitda_basis_note: core_metrics EBITDA is PBT + finance costs + D&A, so it contains interest income, FVTPL investment income, FX differences and associates. Operating adjusted EBITDA (pre-SBC, ex those items): FY2025 8,099.2 - 219.1 - 110.9 + 79.5 FX loss + 18.5 SBC = 7,867 = 23.4% of revenue; H1 FY2025 24.4%; H2 FY2025 22.8%; H1 FY2026 3,294.6 - 126.1 - 69.0 + 153.8 + 4.6 = 3,258 = 21.4%. The margin paths start from the H1 FY2026 21.4%, not the FY2025 23.4%.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, plus the non-US adaptations (RMB flows / HKD quote, one lease treatment, NCI in bridge, matching-asset rule for the deposit and WMP pile). Routed as an operating company: MIXUE earns ~97.6% of revenue selling ingredients, packaging and equipment to ~64,000 franchised stores, i.e. a vertically integrated manufacturer/distributor with a franchise brand on top. It holds no customer deposits or float, so none of the financial-company rows apply. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry, no prior DCF). Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 5,347.5 (OCF 6,039.0 - capex 691.5) - SBC 18.5 - interest income 219.1 = RMB5,109.8m. FY2025 OCF already carried a RMB1.55bn inventory build; H1 FY2026 reported FCF fell to RMB1,719m as trade payables unwound (-378.7m) against a +739.4m inflow a year earlier. Year 1 of the projection (FY2026) is anchored to H1 FY2026 actuals: revenue +2.3%, operating EBITDA margin 21.4%, and H2 FY2026 laps the H2 FY2025 food-delivery-subsidy surge. Management gives no numeric FY2026 guidance.

bear.rationale: The deceleration is structural share loss: Chabaidao, Guming and Hushang Ayi keep out-growing MIXUE, China store closures (2,527 in FY2025) accelerate as franchisee economics erode, and per-store ingredient orders fall faster than new stores add them. Revenue falls ~9% cumulatively over FY2026-FY2028 (H2 FY2026 down against the subsidy-inflated base, then net China closures), returning to ~2% growth only from FY2030. To defend franchisees MIXUE gives up ingredient mark-up, so operating EBITDA margin compresses to ~18% (gross margin already 31.2% -> 29.9% -> 30.4% with S&D and admin costs growing faster than revenue). Includes a food-safety incident costing a year of growth.

base.rationale: FY2026 +1%: H1 +2.3% and H2 roughly flat against the subsidy-inflated H2 FY2025 base (H2 FY2025 revenue 18,685m). Then mid-single-digit growth from net store adds (~+4,000 in 8 months of 2026), Lucky Cup, FULU beer and overseas, with same-store volume flat-to-down in China, fading to 3%. Operating EBITDA margin held at the H1 FY2026 21.4-22% rather than recovering to FY2024-25's 23-25%: gross margin has fallen three periods running and the price war is not over. Capex 2.2-2.5% of revenue (FY2025 2.1%, H1 FY2026 2.2%; FY2023-24 5.8-8.3% was the factory build-out), D&A ex-ROU rising from 1.6% toward 2.0%. Cash tax 22% (FY2025 cash tax paid 21.2% of PBT, H1 FY2026 ETR 22.1%; 25% statutory less Western-development / Hainan preferential rates). WC -8% of the revenue increase: inventory (3.8bn) far exceeds trade payables (1.9bn).

bull.rationale: Management's base-effect explanation is right: growth re-accelerates to low double digits from FY2027 as Lucky Cup and FULU scale on the existing supply chain and Southeast Asia / Central Asia / US add stores; margin recovers toward the FY2024-25 23-24% as the delivery-subsidy war is curbed by the SAMR inquiry and dispenser rollout lifts franchisee throughput.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 30% (above the 15% default): the H1 FY2026 numbers (+2.3% revenue, -14.7% profit, gross margin down three periods) fit share loss at least as well as the base-effect story, and food safety is a recurring single-regulator tail risk. Base 50%: scale and supply-chain cost leadership are real and the store count is still growing. Bull 20% (below the 35% default): it needs several independent things to go right at once (subsidy war regulated down, Lucky Cup and FULU scaling, overseas turning around after Indonesia/Vietnam closures).
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
